description: notify.channel.create refused: an http url without allow_private never becomes a row. The refusal is the whole SV7 shape-check — scheme, userinfo, size caps, the local-only http rule — and every member of the family says the same thing about a different field: this channel as written may not exist or may not send.

data.what: notify: http is accepted only with allow_private=1 and a loopback or private host — for a local receiver, both
data.means: a channel is standing authority to send machine facts off this machine, so its shape is refused before any row exists; nothing half-valid is persisted, and the refusal carries the validator's own sentence
data.todo: fix the named field (https url without userinfo, name <= 80 bytes, subscriptions inside the closed vocabularies) and send the write again
